dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior boundary of the dark band exhibits a wide, shallow U-shaped curvature with no sharp angularity at the midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band is substantial, comprising approximately one-third of the visible dorsal-to-caudal torso span.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a wide white cranial gap approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear at its base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the ears are characterized by a smooth, semi-circular rounded profile.

other_distinctive_markers: The posterior white fur region exhibits significant reddish-brown chromatic variation or staining compared to the brighter white fur of the nuchal region.
